note: First hk-mox year-round offers recipe, written 20 Nov 2026. The public /promotions/year-round-offers/ page is a Gatsby filter UI. Plain HTML does not contain the merchant tiles. The official listing body is the same-origin page-data JSON at /page-data/promotions/year-round-offers/page-data.json, which the page loads. The JSON includes ended offers (endDate before the run day) and live offers. Shared terms are https://mox.com/static/2026YRO-TnC.pdf. There is no per-merchant terms document in the JSON.
